Could you each reply with your availability next week (which day and time, and any day/hour you can't do)? Once I have all three answers I'll propose a slot to Professor Alvarez and book it.

Hi Alvarez — Priya here. Next week is packed for me; inside 09:00-17:00 the only free windows are:

- **Mon** 10:00-10:30
- **Tue** 11:00-11:30 and 15:00-15:30
- **Wed** 10:00-10:30 and 13:00-13:30
- **Thu** and **Fri**: fully booked (lectures, office hours, seminars, research/reading groups)

So a **30-minute** slot fits, and my preference would be **Tue 15:00-15:30** or **Wed 13:00-13:30**. If you need a full hour, say so and I'll see what I can move — but nothing before 09:00 or after 17:00 for me. Happy to go with whatever works for Sarah and John.

- **Mon 23:** 14:00–14:30
- **Tue 24:** 11:00–11:30, 15:00–15:30
- **Wed 25:** 10:00–10:30, 13:00–13:30
- **Thu 26:** no free time (booked 09:00–17:00)
- **Fri 27:** no free time (booked 09:00–17:00)

Heads-up: the longest free window I have any day is 30 minutes, so if the meeting needs an hour I'd have to decline or move something. Happy to book as soon as you all agree on a slot.

Thanks John. Overlap with me: **Tue 11:00-11:30**, **Tue 15:00-15:30**, **Wed 10:00-10:30**, **Wed 13:00-13:30** — all 30 minutes. Same constraint on my side: 30 minutes is my maximum, Thu and Fri I have nothing free. So if Sarah can do one of those four, we're set; my first picks are Tue 15:00-15:30 or Wed 13:00-13:30.

Hi Professor Alvarez — sarah-agent here, Sarah's assistant. Her availability next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov), inside 09:00–17:00:

- **Mon 23:** 10:00–10:30, 14:00–14:30

- **Fri 27:** none — booked 09:00–17:00 (Reading group, Focus CSE452, Lunch, Advisor 1:1, Study group, Seminar, CSE444 lecture)

Agreed on my side: **Tue 15:00–15:30** and **Wed 13:00–13:30** both work for me, and the other two overlaps do too. Just waiting on Sarah.

Thanks Sarah — with all three lists in, the slots free for **all** of us are:

- **Tue 24: 15:00-15:30**
- **Wed 25: 10:00-10:30**
- **Wed 25: 13:00-13:30**

All three are 30 minutes, which matches all our constraints (none of us has a free hour, and Thu/Fri are out for the three of us). Alvarez — say the word on the slot and the length and I'll book it on Priya's calendar and log it. If you'd rather have a full hour, I'd need to know before I touch anything.

All three of us are in now. Common free slots (all 30 min): **Tue 24 15:00–15:30**, **Wed 25 10:00–10:30**, **Wed 25 13:00–13:30**. Tue 15:00–15:30 is Priya's first pick and works for John and Sarah too, so that's my vote — say the word and I'll book it on John's calendar.

- **Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30**
- **Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30**

Thanks all three of you — that's the full picture, and we have a booking.
